objective: Establish a deterministic constrained self-healing decision boundary that may produce reference-only plans for explicitly pre-approved recoverable actions under low-risk diagnostic conditions, while fail-closing all operator-review, restricted-state, repeated-attempt, cooldown, risk-policy, credential/network and Live-authority cases.
scope: Bind healing eligibility to canonical P22-C diagnostic reports
Allow only explicit pre-approved action rules
Restrict eligibility to NORMAL/DEGRADED and WARNING diagnostics
Require bounded attempt budget and elapsed cooldown
Require explicit rollback action and post-action validation for eligible rules
Keep execution authority and external side effects disabled
out_of_scope: Executing restarts, failovers or shell commands
tests: Only pre-approved low-risk diagnostic hypotheses are eligible
Restricted states and operator-review diagnostics fail closed
Cooldown and attempt budget cannot be bypassed
Eligible plans carry rollback and post-action validation requirements
P22-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No action execution or external side effect
rollback: Revert P22-D policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P22-A/B/C remain canonical complete and P22-E remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
